scheme_name: CSIR Research Associateship for Industry Projects
overview: The CSIR Research Associateship for Industry Projects is a scheme under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India, aimed at promoting industry-oriented research and innovation through research associateships. It supports individuals engaged in industry-linked R&D projects, fostering collaboration between CSIR laboratories and industrial partners. The scheme focuses on translating scientific research into practical applications and enhancing technological capabilities in industries.
objectives: Strengthen collaboration between CSIR laboratories and industrial entities
Support research associates working on industry-linked projects
Facilitate technology transfer and commercialization of R&D outcomes
Enhance innovation and competitiveness of Indian industries
eligibility: The eligibility criteria are not explicitly detailed in the provided evidence text.
benefits: The benefits include financial support for research associates engaged in industry projects, opportunities to work on applied R&D in CSIR laboratories, and contribution to technology development and industrial innovation.
